adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (i.e., it can be `null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both the event type and organizer lack a destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` is skipped and the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never added. This matches the finding: collective hosts’ calendars can be silently dropped, preventing per-host calendar event creation via the new array-based destinationCalendar logic.
